name: 2D Pachinko Game
author: nmjcreates
description: I made this Pachinko Game for foundations of unity real time 2D development. To make the truck move, I applied a force and then calculated what the change in position would be. I then appended the position accordingly. I used collision detectors to allow the hat to collect coins and to play audio queues. I have several coin generators above the visible area, which every now and again will spawn coins randomly inside some area. For the score counter I added a text object and had the collision detector in the hat update when a coin collided with it.
